compact_rounding_after_final_build.summary: ▼Plant-based - Pumpkin Seeds 11.21 g per 100 g - dried

limitations: Verified occurrence does not mean a measured quantity, ordinary-food intervention equivalence or delivery to the receiving tissue.
Glutamine and glutamate are protein-bound forms; gene-sequence estimates are not displayed as measured food amounts.
NAC remains supplemental. Native FOS leads do not resolve the specific oligofructose material identity; a separate identity/material adjudication would be needed.
No new derived pathway was necessary or manufactured. Existing B6 and riboflavin conversion records remain unchanged.
EAA ranking is within 20 reviewed foods, by a common as-eaten 100 g basis. Different water contents and portions prevent interpreting it as a protein-quality or universal best-food ranking.

USDA profiles retain all nine individual amino-acid quantities, nutrient-row IDs and derivation IDs, with same-record protein and source-specific portion data. Not every value is a new laboratory measurement. No missing constituent was filled with zero.
Compact PM totals are rounded to at most two decimals to fit the canonical value column. Full calculated totals and individual source values remain unchanged in the dataset and detailed disclosure.
Existing food-page limiting-amino-acid and protein-quality narratives are preserved; they have not been newly established from these composition totals.
Egg and lentil digestibility evidence remains source-specific; no matched ileal correction or fabricated DIAAS was assigned.
The first build exposed one TSX syntax error, corrected before the final build. Three obsolete foodless fixtures were replaced with source-specific positive and no-borrowed-quantity assertions.
